title: Card numbers in the redacted contact drivers report
scenario: Finance paused the weekly service desk contact drivers CSV after it showed full corporate card numbers, although conversational analytics redaction is enabled in the flow and the report job only had a small dedupe fix. You get the S3 mirror of the Analysis/Voice prefix, the flow's analytics block and its last change, the report job's git log, CloudTrail reads and the IAM policy.
task: Trace which S3 objects the report reads and why they contain card numbers
Connect the flow change, the dedupe fix and the leak; rule out the red herring
Fix the job: redacted objects only, body check, one row per contact, Luhn scrub
Least-privilege IAM for the job role on the redacted prefix
Root cause with evidence and follow-ups in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Report reads only Analysis/Voice/Redacted objects and refuses non-redacted bodies
No Luhn-valid card number in the CSV; one row per contact; earlier contacts back
Job role can only list/read the redacted prefix
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
